mapper.sql: SELECT f.user_id AS userId, SUM(f.win) AS win, SUM(f.lose) AS lose, SUM(f.draw) AS draw, SUM(f.total) AS total, MAX(f.date) AS date, u.nick_name AS nickName, u.small_icon AS smallIcon FROM t_free_game_singleresult f JOIN t_user u ON u.userid = f.user_id WHERE f.date BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} GROUP BY f.user_id, u.nick_name, u.small_icon
mapper.select: HAVING total > 0 ORDER BY total DESC, userId LIMIT #{rankcount}
SELECT me.*, 0 AS `rank` FROM () me WHERE me.userId = #{userId}
SELECT SUM(f.total) FROM t_free_game_total f JOIN t_user u ON f.user_id = u.userid WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY SUM(total) DESC
